newsitem.title: UK: Pace wins 25 mln stg Canal Plus contract.
newsitem.headline: Pace wins 25 mln stg Canal Plus contract.

text.p: Satellite receiver manufacturer Pace Micro Technology said on Thursday it had signed a contract with France's Canal Plus to supply more than 25 million stg worth of digital satellite receiver decoders for the French market.

"The volume of this order, added to the new contracts recently announced by Pace, has led the company to begin installation of an additional digital production line at its Shipley manufacturing facility," Pace said in a statement.

Pace, which is based in Shipley, West Yorkshire, said the Canal Plus contract "opens further significant digital opportunities" in France, where the company has "traditionally enjoyed significant market share for analogue products".
